expected_required.argv: EXACT native argv list strings; argv0 absolute selected native image
expected_required.working_directory: absolute Windows cwd exactly joined by PureWindowsPath; no filesystem normalization/query

expected_optional.run_id: exact public UUID if prospectively captured; omit otherwise

audit_record.pass_criterion: audit_state==qualified_full_lifetime_close AND lifetime_passed is True AND actual_job_close_passed is True AND collector_close_passed is True. This does not assert correct public state, killed members, physics or new runtime admission.
audit_record.members: All original retained members, never only job_pids_before: identity/image/role/capture provenance/exit proof/pre_request_category live_before_request or early_exited_before_request or not_applicable; live is an observation not causal kill proof.
audit_record.forced_schema: Original227 force schema has no serialized full notification trace. Full original HANDLE capture+identity+image+membership, exact final originalJob TotalProcesses=count, each exit+empty Job and real close are independently required. If any trace is supplied it is fully checked and cannot be ignored. Missing exported trace explicitly reported, never synthesized. Raw false prospective summary is retained, not an independent evidence substitute.

expectation_optional.control_terminal_states: predeclared allowed state list for controlled disposal; default completed

assert_public_state.purpose: Public-state assertions separate from lifetime audit. Natural races retain completed/failed state and stop_achieved=False; never label forced completed or promote227 historicalcleanup_failed.

audit_control_survival.samples: EXACT phases before_target_trigger,after_target_terminal,before_control_cleanup. Each actual same-original-launch-HANDLE identity/image + GetProcessTimes identity_source + raw zero-timeout WAIT_TIMEOUT258 + captured IsProcessInJob true/success/token and timestamp. Before/after target actual request/terminal close time; final control audit must close the SAME birth/image/originalJob and distincttargetJob; borrowed PIDs do not prove survival.
audit_control_survival.pass_criterion: control original lifetime+close passes, all three originalHANDLE live samples fit chronology, distinct Job/birth, same native executable image across target/control. Final control cleanup may be separately cancelled after samples; no control physics implied.

rules: No product/CLI/common predicates imported or invoked

No rawrecord mutation or synthesized flags
